parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the kettle, typically made of stainless steel or heat-resistant plastic, designed to cover the top opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents heat and steam from escaping and can be removed to fill the kettle with water.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated to open and close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the kettle, made of heat-resistant plastic to allow safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting and pouring the kettle safely without direct contact with hot surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kettle, made of stainless steel, forming the container for holding and heating water.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the water and transfers heat efficiently from the heating element to the liquid.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural core of the kettle.
